messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Standard errors of the location parameters of a PCM in mirt?
parts:
It sounds like you're looking for the rating scale model rather than the (generalized) partial credit model. This has a parameter intended to reflect the item ability, but makes the structural assumption that the distance between each category is constant for all items. 

Phil
